plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp build phase for boxing with extra conditioning support. Week 1 establishes simple bodyweight performance baselines and introduces the main movements. Weeks 2-3 build lower-body and upper-body strength endurance, explosive intent, trunk strength, and boxing-friendly conditioning without excessive soreness. Week 4 is a deload that keeps speed and movement quality high while cutting fatigue. After Week 4, the next block should review progress and adjust exercise difficulty, volume, and conditioning dose before intensifying.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength, power, trunk control, and aerobic-repeated effort capacity with simple bodyweight methods.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress exercise difficulty and conditioning density while keeping recovery steady around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength and power, then express them faster with sharper boxing-specific output and lower fatigue.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Use perfect reps only. Hands under shoulders, body straight, chest to the floor depth you can control. This sets your baseline for future progress.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your best clean set and stop before form breaks.

substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor push-ups are too hard to perform cleanly.
